title: prompts follow the last input device
why: His order (2026-10-18): "player should get key prompts if that is the last input they used -- xbox controller prompts should only pop up if player is actively using the controller -- e.g. real time glyph switching -- fortnite does a great job with this". The game showed pad prompts whenever a pad was plugged in. Each window now keeps the last input device it saw: any key press, mouse click, wheel turn or mouse move of more than 6 pixels is the keyboard, a pad button press or a stick push past its deadzone is the pad (drift and a held stick never flip it). padOn(), the one reader every prompt asks, is true only for a connected pad that is also the last device used, and the body.padon class that drives the DOM hints follows it the same frame. The player 2 window, which has no keyboard or mouse of its own, keeps the pad prompts. Twenty canvas and DOM hints that read the connected pad directly now ask the same reader.
now: Prompts follow what you used last: press a key and you see keys, touch the controller and you see its buttons.
